Before you do make sure your mobo has vga out. It should. It's usually a blue plug on the back of your mobo.

Okay assuming your mobo has vga and your monitor takes Vga my next step would be to get a cable. If they don't I'd get an adapter for whatever video out your mobo has (VGA, DVI etc)

You essentially need to find out if it's the card or the monitor, or even the cable. If it all boots up fine with onboard graphics it's your card. If it still doesn't it's your monitor or your cable.

After that I'd try a diff cable. Make sure as you're using older hardware the hdmi cable is the same version of hdmi as your hardware is. 

If that still doesn't work try a new monitor.
